files.about: The app's canvas: pages of containers and widgets.
Each Launch's build of the app.

words.title: Streamlit app
words.for_whom: Anyone who wants a small web app on their data, for themselves or their team.
words.explain: Draw containers on a canvas and insert widgets: charts, tables, filters and buttons, each with its properties. A filter widget sets a value the other widgets read.
words.example: A sales dashboard with a region filter, a chart by month and a table of the top customers.
